rationale: Independently rebuilt the proposed catalog byte-for-byte from the exact frozen candidate and both complete semantic reviews. Independently reran the actual serving audit to an identical artifact, verifying all current source bindings, no-goal play and all 32 goal variants, every canonical pair result, private recipes and both historical prefix sets. Added 50 randomized complete-world runs, 50 current checkpoint restores, 100 randomized historical checkpoint migrations across the 75- and 111-concept books, and 100 actual live-session upgrades through the current implementation. Every full run reached 221 concepts and 117 crafted discoveries without goal-dependent recipes. All earned historical pairs/concepts remained intact. Distinguishes 96 later supplied concepts and 8 starters from craftable discoveries, and 174 unchanged-KG identities from 47 authored world-local concepts. The exact semantic review covers all 169 added recipes and 110 added definitions; 116 old recipe judgments and 111 old concept records remain byte-identical. Factual acceptance concerns the curated game associations and disclosed culinary simplifications, not unique real-world derivations or complete cooking instructions. No human playtest or enjoyment measurement is inferred from these automated replays.
